name: Support triage
description: Route a request, assess urgency, and spot refund or cancellation intent.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this customer request?

criteria.technical: Bugs, broken features, outages or access failures
criteria.sales: Pricing, plans or a new purchase

urgency.instructions: How urgently does this customer need help?
criteria: Routine question; no deadline or loss of access
Work is blocked, a service is down, or immediate action is needed

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request money back or a refund?

cancellation_risk.instructions: Does the customer explicitly say they may cancel or stop using the service?

samples.name: Duplicate payment
samples.state: I was charged twice for my September subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge today. If this is not fixed, I will cancel our account.

state.subject: Our production workspace is unavailable
state.body: Everyone gets a 503 error when signing in. Our customer demo starts in 30 minutes. Please restore access immediately.

samples.name: Pricing question
samples.state: Hello, could you share your annual team pricing? We are evaluating options for next quarter. There is no deadline yet.

samples.name: Filipino refund
samples.state: Dalawang beses akong nasingil para sa subscription ko. Pakibalik ang sobrang bayad. Kapag hindi ito naayos ngayong araw, kakanselahin ko ang account ko.

name: Document routing
description: Choose from ten document schemas, with an explicit unknown category. This classifies text; it does not extract arbitrary fields.

document_type.instructions: Which document schema best matches this text? Select other when no schema fits.

criteria.invoice: Bill requesting payment for goods or services
criteria.receipt: Proof that payment has been made
criteria.safety_data_sheet: Chemical hazards, handling and first aid
criteria.certificate: Formal declaration of compliance or certification
criteria.other: None of the listed document schemas

payment_due.instructions: Does this document request a payment that is still due?

completeness.instructions: How complete is the supplied document excerpt for understanding its purpose?
criteria: Identifiable purpose but some important context missing
Clear document purpose and relevant supporting details

name: Feedback signals
description: Turn a short review into a topic, an ordinal satisfaction score, and a feature-request signal.

primary_topic.instructions: What is the main topic of this product feedback?

criteria.usability: Ease of use, navigation or user interface
criteria.pricing: Price, subscription or value for money

satisfaction.instructions: How satisfied is the reviewer with the product?

feature_request.instructions: Does this feedback explicitly ask for a new feature or capability?
